summary: File management app with a My Files section featuring a table layout, folder/file icons, sticky header, and action menus.

existing_features.title: In the My Files section, add a 'Rename' action button to the bulk selection action bar, positioned immediately before the existing 'Move' button. The Rename action in bulk mode should open a rename dialog (or trigger rename for the selected item if only one is selected). Include an appropriate rename icon on the button.

In the My Files section, add a 'Rename' menu item to the vertical three-dot (ellipsis) context menu for each file/folder row, positioned immediately before the existing 'Move' item. Clicking it should open the rename dialog for that file or folder. Include an appropriate rename icon.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add 'Rename' option to bulk action bar (before 'Move') and vertical three-dot menu (before 'Move') in My Files section
